description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organized a 1-hour-30-minute session on “Study Techniques and Goal Setting” for the Class 9 students of Matunga Premier School on 31st August 2026. The session was conducted by Rtn. Dr. Ajay Darekar, a transformational trainer and mentor with over 22 years of experience. The session was designed to help students develop effective study habits, understand the importance of goal setting, and gain greater clarity about their aspirations and purpose. The objective was to go beyond conventional academic guidance and encourage students to reflect on why they study, what they wish to achieve, and how they can take purposeful steps towards their goals. Students were encouraged to understand that academic success is not simply about studying harder, but about studying smarter, developing the right habits, managing their time effectively, and working consistently towards clearly defined goals. The session was highly interactive.
